title: Xiaomi reports Q3 revenue down 5.2% YoY to ~$16.1B, its third straight quarter of decline, and net income down 68% to ~$585M, as memory shortages weigh on sales (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Xiaomi reports Q3 revenue down 5.2% YoY to ~$16.1B, its third straight quarter of decline, and net income down 68% to ~$585M, as memory shortages weigh on sales — Xiaomi Corp. reported a revenue contraction for the third quarter in a row while it grapples with a global memory crunch that's hobbled …
